purpose: Agent-only entry point for validating comparison identity, toolchain provenance, correctness, measurement protocol, benchmark stability, and profiler provenance before accepting report claims.

prohibited_claims: mixing with the superseded CuteDSL 4.5.2 run

required_assertions.check: correctness.json#/all_paired_gates_pass equals true; every case 256, 1024, 8192 has paired_gate_pass=true; every arm has formal_pass=true; fixture hashes match their dedicated manifests
environment, protocol, artifact, comparison_group_id, rerun_id, and per-arm artifact fingerprints match evidence.identity.json in every consumed benchmark/profile artifact

benchmark_raw.csv contains 3 M x 2 arms x 5 repeats; paired order and identity are valid; summary statistics are reproducible from raw; every summary row has stable_le_5_percent=True; comparison speedup is reproducible from summary and every comparison row has formal_comparison=True
toolchain_identity.reconstructed.json#/status remains identity-incomplete; reject compiler-causality and cross-build claims
all consumed NSys and NCU profile manifests match the canonical comparison/rerun/environment/protocol/artifact identity before their data is used

timing_authority.prohibited: NCU duration is not a production performance-time authority

operator_range_ncu.coverage: one complete CUDA Graph replay per arm, including 2 fused or 9 chain material kernels
operator_range_ncu.allowed: compatible additive DRAM, L2, request, local-address-space, TMA, and dynamic-instruction counters

deep_launch_ncu.coverage: fused main kernel and selected chain launches only
deep_launch_ncu.allowed: launch-local resources, rates, SOL, stalls, cadence, and source/SASS evidence
deep_launch_ncu.prohibited: summing node-replay DRAM/L2 into an operator total or assigning a fused whole-kernel value to an internal phase

nsys.allowed: actual kernel nodes, GPU intervals, overlap/gap, and graph-level host correlation
nsys.prohibited: TensorCore/stall attribution or fused-internal phase duration

memory_observation_points.DRAM: physical device-DRAM/off-chip read and write bytes
memory_observation_points.L2: L2 sector traffic using the total authority counter
memory_observation_points.LSU_global: L1TEX LSU T-stage sectorized global request footprint; excludes TMA
memory_observation_points.TMA: TMA global-interface traffic; separate from LSU
memory_observation_points.local: local-address-space request footprint; not DRAM bytes or source-object spill proof
memory_observation_points.rule: Never add DRAM, L2, LSU global, TMA, or local into one total-global/GMEM quantity

rollup_rules.sum: only compatible additive counts over non-duplicated scope
rollup_rules.timeline_union: duration, overlap, and gaps from one declared NSys window
rollup_rules.no_rollup: occupancy, SOL, IPC, eligible warps, stall percentages, cache hit rate, and other launch-local ratios

agent_policy: Validate every canonical input SHA256 before reading derived claims.
Treat a missing artifact, digest mismatch, failed assertion, or stale profile identity as a validation failure; do not ask the report reader to adjudicate it.
Keep detailed environment, toolchain, correctness, and protocol evidence out of the reader-facing bottleneck report.
Only expose evidence-identity limitations in the report if they directly invalidate or qualify a displayed conclusion.
